data.summary: Power Platform Developer with 4+ years of experience delivering automation and enterprise application solutions that improve productivity and streamline business operations. Skilled in PowerApps (Canvas & Model-Driven Apps), Microsoft Dataverse, Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop RPA), Business Process Flows, system integrations and Power BI. responsibilities: Designed and implemented an enterprise-level SLA Escalation & Incident Monitoring System using Power Automate, Dataverse, and SharePoint Online to streamline incident tracking and escalation workflows.
Configured SharePoint lists and Dataverse tables to store incident records, SLA timelines, escalation matrices, and audit logs with role-based access.
Developed scheduled Power Automate flows to continuously evaluate ticket aging, SLA thresholds, and pending resolution tasks.

Built Model-Driven Apps for task assignment and project tracking, including Business Process Flows and custom views. (Project Task & Resource Management System)

projects.name: 1. Employee Skill Tracker & Performance Management System
projects.description:
1. Employee Skill Tracker & Performance Management System
Technologies: PowerApps (Canvas Apps), Dataverse, Power Automate, Office 365 Outlook / Teams
Role: Power Platform Developer
Designed and developed a role-based Canvas App to manage employee skills, certifications, and performance records.
Built custom Dataverse tables with relationships to support scalable data structure.
Implemented CRUD operations using Power FX and Patch() for optimized data updates.
Created responsive UI with reusable components and conditional visibility rules.
Integrated Power Automate to trigger email alerts and reminders for performance reviews.
Applied role-based access control for secure and contextual data visibility.
Reduced manual HR tracking efforts by ~45%, improving data consistency and transparency.
Improved performance review timelines by ~30% via automated workflows & notifications.
2. Automated Incident Escalation & SLA Monitoring System
Technologies: Power Automate Cloud Flows, Dataverse, Outlook / Teams, Power BI
Role: Power Automate Developer
Created scheduled cloud flows to monitor incident SLA thresholds and trigger escalations.
Integrated Dataverse, Teams & Outlook for end-to-end notification & approval workflows.
Designed adaptive card notifications in Microsoft Teams for real-time action & approval.
Implemented switch cases, parallel branches, and dynamic expressions for multi-tier escalation.
Logged escalation metrics into Dataverse for SLA compliance dashboards in Power BI.
Reduced manual SLA monitoring effort by ~60% with automated tracking and alerts.
Improved incident resolution time by ~40% through proactive escalation workflows.
Reduced SLA breach rate by ~25% using early alerts and automated follow-ups.
3. Task & Resource Management System
Technologies: Model-Driven Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Power BI
Role: Power Platform Developer
Architected a Model-Driven App for project task planning, resource allocation, and workload oversight.
Configured Dataverse tables, forms, views, and dashboards for streamlined data workflows.
Implemented Business Process Flows to automate stage transitions and approval steps.
Orchestrated task notifications, SLA follow-ups, and reminders using Power Automate flows.
Enhanced reporting visibility and planning accuracy by ~35%, reducing manual coordination effort by ~50%.
4. Automated Invoice Data Extraction & ERP Entry (RPA)
Technologies: Power Automate Desktop (UI Automation & OCR), Cloud Flows, Dataverse, AI Builder
Role: RPA / Power Automate Desktop Developer
Designed an OCR-driven invoice data extraction flow using AI Builder.
Automated legacy ERP data entry via PAD UI-based RPA workflows.
Instituted validation checks, exception logs, and audit controls using Dataverse tables.
Enabled unattended bot execution with retry logic and fault-tolerant error handling.
Decreased invoice processing effort by ~70% and reduced data entry errors by ~45%, lowering operational cost by ~30%.
